meta.title: Image Switch
meta.description: Choose which backend generate_image talks to, and keep a key per backend. Ships with local Stable Diffusion (127.0.0.1:1235), Volcengine Ark / Doubao Seedream, AutoDL.Art and any OpenAI-compatible /images/generations service; add, edit or remove backends yourself. Open Settings → Image routing (right after Models) and press "Set default" on a backend — that choice is pushed into dsh-model-think-level, so later generate_image calls need no model argument. "Test" spends one real generation on the selected backend (local is free, cloud calls are billed by that provider). Keys are stored in ~/.dsh/image-switch/keys.json (mode 600) and never written into the profile config; when no key is saved the plugin falls back to the backend's env var or the ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml refs. Turning the bundle off removes the Settings page and the image_router tool, and the standalone endpoint on port 1236 stops listening, so generate_image falls back to whatever provider rows the profile still declares.
